# bracketed-spans

```````````````````````````````` example
[text]{.class} [x]{#id .c k="v"}
.
Document scope=1:1..1:32 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:32 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Span scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={.class} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:15..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Span scope=1:16..1:32 anchor="id" attributes={.c k="v"} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:17..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[]{}
.
Document scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Span scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[*a* b]{.c} [a [b] c]{.c}
.
Document scope=1:1..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Span scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={.c} children=2
    │   ├── Emphasis scope=1:2..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    │   └── Text scope=1:5..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:12..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Span scope=1:13..1:25 anchor=null attributes={.c} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:14..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a [b] c" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[text]{.key}

[text]: /u
.
Document scope=1:1..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Span scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={.key} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:2..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[text](/u){.c} [text][r]{.c}

[r]: /r
.
Document scope=1:1..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:28 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Link scope=1:1..1:14 anchor=null attributes={.c} dest=url("/u") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:15..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Link scope=1:16..1:28 anchor=null attributes={.c} dest=url("/r") title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=1:17..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[see [a](/u) here]{.c}
.
Document scope=1:1..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Span scope=1:1..1:22 anchor=null attributes={.c} children=3
        ├── Text scope=1:2..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="see " children=0
        ├── Link scope=1:6..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("/u") title=null children=1
        │   └── Text scope=1:7..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
        └── Text scope=1:13..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" here" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[[wiki]]{.x}
.
Document scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── CrossLink scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} dest=cross(path="wiki",anchor=null) label=null children=0
    └── Text scope=1:9..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="{.x}" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
:a[[x]{.c}]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Directive scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} name="a" children=0
        └── DirectiveLabel scope=1:3..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Span scope=1:4..1:10 anchor=null attributes={.c} children=1
                └── Text scope=1:5..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[text]{.c [text] {.c} [text]{.1}
.
Document scope=1:1..1:32 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:32 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=1:1..1:32 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[text]{.c [text] {.c} [text]{.1}" children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Composition and fallback

```````````````````````````````` example
[x]{} []{#empty} [x]{#first #last .a .a id=record class="b b" k=1 k=2 empty=}
.
Document scope=1:1..1:77 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:77 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Span scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:6..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Span scope=1:7..1:16 anchor="empty" attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:17..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Span scope=1:18..1:77 anchor="record" attributes={.a .a .b .b k="1" k="2" empty=""} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:19..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[a\]b]{.c} [`]`]{.c} [a\[b]{.c}
.
Document scope=1:1..1:31 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:31 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Span scope=1:1..1:10 anchor=null attributes={.c} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a]b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:11..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Span scope=1:12..1:20 anchor=null attributes={.c} children=1
    │   └── Code scope=1:13..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="]" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:21..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Span scope=1:22..1:31 anchor=null attributes={.c} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:23..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a[b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[a
b]{.c}
.
Document scope=1:1..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Span scope=1:1..2:6 anchor=null attributes={.c} children=3
        ├── Text scope=1:2..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
        ├── SoftBreak scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
        └── Text scope=2:1..2:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[[wiki]]{.x} ![[wiki]]{.x}
.
Document scope=1:1..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
    ├── CrossLink scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} dest=cross(path="wiki",anchor=null) label=null children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:9..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="{.x} " children=0
    ├── CrossEmbedded scope=1:14..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} dest=cross(path="wiki",anchor=null) label=null dimensions=null children=0
    └── Text scope=1:23..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} literal="{.x}" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
[x](u){.c} [x][r]{.c} [r][]{.c} [r]{.span}

[r]: /u {.inherited}
.
Document scope=1:1..3:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:42 anchor=null attributes={} children=7
    ├── Link scope=1:1..1:10 anchor=null attributes={.c} dest=url("u") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:11..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Link scope=1:12..1:21 anchor=null attributes={.inherited .c} dest=url("/u") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:13..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:22..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Link scope=1:23..1:31 anchor=null attributes={.inherited .c} dest=url("/u") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:24..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} literal="r" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:32..1:32 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    └── Span scope=1:33..1:42 anchor=null attributes={.span} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:34..1:34 anchor=null attributes={} literal="r" children=0
````````````````````````````````


```````````````````````````````` example
[^n]{.x} [^[note]]{.x} ^[note]{.x}

[^n]: note
.
Document scope=1:1..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:34 anchor=null attributes={} children=6
│   ├── Span scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={.x} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="^n" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:9..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Span scope=1:10..1:22 anchor=null attributes={.x} children=1
│   │   └── Cite scope=1:11..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── Citation scope=1:13..1:16 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│   │           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │           └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:23..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=1:24..1:30 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:26..1:29 referent=footnote(id="inline-2") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   └── Text scope=1:31..1:34 anchor=null attributes={} literal="{.x}" children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:11..1:17 id="inline-1" children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:13..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="note" children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:24..1:30 id="inline-2" children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:26..1:29 anchor=null attributes={} literal="note" children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..3:10 id="n" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=3:7..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="note" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
![^n]{.c} ![^n]

[^n]: note
.
Document scope=1:1..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="!" children=0
│   ├── Span scope=1:2..1:9 anchor=null attributes={.c} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="^n" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:10..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" !" children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:12..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:13..1:14 referent=footnote(id="n") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=3:1..3:10 id="n" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=3:7..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=3:7..3:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="note" children=0
````````````````````````````````
